positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "In Congress, I’ve worked to preserve qualified immunity and getting officers the resources they need."

Rated 100% by the National Association of Police Organizations (NAPO
Voted against HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "As a Member of the Armed Services Committee, I was proud to vote for this year’s National Defense Authorization Act to FULLY fund our military, increase salaries for our soldiers, and strengthen our military bases in South Florida!"
"Congress must reduce spending, bolster our military capabilities, and avoid shutting down the government!"
Voted in favor of HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted in favor of HR 8774: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2025"

Voted against HR 3684 "Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act"
Voted in favor of HR 2811 "Limit, Save, Grow Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Americans are experiencing the highest inflation in 40 years. Real, every day, hardworking Americans are struggling to put food on the table and meet basic necessities. Biden’s massive, multi-trillion dollar tax-and-spend policies are to blame."

"There are 2 things you don’t do in a recession: 1) Spend more money when you have inflation 2) Raise taxes The Biden Administration has done BOTH with their Bill. American families are already struggling - this is not what we need."
Voted against HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

"Failed "Bidenomics" is entirely responsible for the cost-of-living crisis & record inflation American families are facing. This #SuperBowl Sunday is one of the most expensive BECAUSE of Biden’s failed tax & spend policies!"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "The problem with Biden’s student debt cancellation plan is it gives money to the top percent of Americans. Now, every day, hard-working Americans will pay higher taxes in order to bail them out. It’s not the right thing to do."
Voted against HR 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "Americans SUPPORT voter ID laws and ensuring our elections are safe and secure. As one of the only Members of Congress who actually has had to implement election protocols, I speak on authority when it comes to our elections – the bill was a travesty for American voters."

"Pelosi wants a federal takeover of elections. Unlike her, I actually implemented election security protocols as Mayor of Miami-Dade County. I reject: ❌ Taxpayer-funded campaigns ❌ Weaponizing the FEC and the IRS ❌ Ending voter ID laws ❌ Destroying the 1st amendment"
Voted against HR 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Energy needs an all the above approach, and we have plenty of it here in America. It’s too bad Biden is set on destroying our oil and gas industry while pushing for Green New Deal nonsense. Let’s invest in oil and gas, in renewables, and nuclear. Let’s invest in America."
Rated 3% by the League of Conservation Voters
Voted in favor of HR 1 "Lower Energy Costs Act"

"Obama advisors recommend we import more oil from Saudi Arabia and Iran rather than producing more HERE. I don’t know about you but I want to put American oil, American people, and American jobs FIRST."

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "Did you know that President Biden is lifting oil sanctions on Nicolas Maduro’s brutal regime in #Venezuela? Socialist Venezuela is allied with the regime in Iran, which is funding Hamas’ terrorist war against #Israel. Biden’s policy is truly pathetic."

"President Biden has been totally INCOMPETENT on #Iran. Biden has loosened sanctions on the regime in Iran, which has allowed the Ayatollah to funnel even more money to Hamas terrorists in Gaza. America must toughen up on #Iran & fully support #Israel!"
"The military dictatorship in #Cuba is welcoming Russian military ships to their ports and yet President Biden is rewarding the Castro regime’s pathetic behavior with sanctions relief!"
"The sanctions must REIMPOSED NOW & #Iran must face MAJOR consequences for targeting & murdering US troops!"

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "Meeting with dear friends from #Ukraine’s Parliament on US support for their defense against brutal dictator Vladimir Putin’s murderous invasion of their country."
"We stand with the brave people of #Ukraine in their struggle for freedom against Putin’s despicable, murderous invasion."

"While I disagree with the Biden Administration’s strategy, abandoning #Ukraine right now sends an awful message that the US is not a reliable security partner — especially at a time when Communist #China is threatening so many of our allies."
Voted in favor of HR 8035 "Ukraine Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Ban. TikTok. Now!"

"The Communist regime in Beijing is harvesting data from millions of Americans through #TikTok. The Senate just passed a #TikTok ban on all government devices. This must be expanded to include all American devices — now!"
